## Duty, tax and documents by country

### USA

Indian-made women's garments entering the USA pay the **normal (MFN) duty** for their HTS code **plus an additional 10% tariff on Indian goods** (as of November 2026). The **$800 de minimis exemption is suspended**, so every shipment pays duty. Shipments up to **$2,500** can usually use **informal entry**; above that you need a **formal entry and customs bond**. Garments must carry **fibre content, "Made in India" and care labels**.

#### Duty at a glance

| Item | USA rule (Nov 2026) |
|---|---|
| Base duty (MFN) | Depends on the HTS line and fibre; cotton is lower than synthetic fabrics like georgette |
| Additional tariff on Indian goods | 10% |
| De minimis ($800) | Suspended – all shipments pay duty |
| Informal entry | Up to $2,500 |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

Because rates depend on the exact HTS line, ask your customs broker for the rate on each style before you order in bulk.

#### Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **EIN** (or CBP-assigned importer number)
- A **customs bond** for formal entries over $2,500

#### Labelling (required)

Under the US Textile Act and FTC rules, garments need:
- **Fibre content** (e.g. "100% Cotton")
- **Country of origin** ("Made in India")
- **Manufacturer or dealer identity** (RN number or company name)
- A permanent **care label**

We can stitch labels to your specifications.

#### Tips to manage costs

- Choose **cotton** styles where possible, as cotton often has a lower base duty than synthetics
- Consolidate orders into fewer, larger shipments
- Factor duty into your retail price from the start

### UK

Under the **UK–India Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA)**, in force since **15 July 2026**, women's garments made in India (HS chapter 62, such as kurtis, kurta sets and Anarkali suits) can be imported into the UK at **0% customs duty**, down from the standard **12%**. You still pay **20% import VAT**, which VAT-registered businesses can usually reclaim. You need a **GB EORI number** and **proof of Indian origin** to claim the 0% rate.

#### Duty and VAT at a glance

| Item | UK rule |
|---|---|
| Standard duty (MFN) | 12% |
| Duty for Indian-origin goods under CETA | **0%** |
| Import VAT | 20% (reclaimable if VAT registered) |
| Low-value parcels | Consignments of £135 or less have duty relief and VAT is charged at the point of sale; this relief is due to end by October 2028 |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

#### Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** (Importer Exporter Code) on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **GB EORI** number
- **Proof of origin** for the 0% CETA rate: an origin declaration from the exporter, a certificate of origin, or the importer's own knowledge, as the agreement allows

#### Labelling

UK law requires **fibre content** labels on textile products (Textile Products (Labelling and Fibre Composition) Regulations 2012). Care and country-of-origin labels are good practice. We can stitch your own labels with the correct fibre content.

### Canada

Indian women's garments entering Canada usually pay **18% customs duty** plus **GST (5%)** and any **provincial tax** (HST or PST). You need a **CRA Business Number with an import account** and to be registered in **CARM**. Labels must show **fibre content in English and French** and a **CA dealer identification number**.

#### Duty and tax at a glance

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Customs duty (MFN) | 18% (confirm your exact tariff line) |
| GST | 5% |
| Provincial tax | HST or PST depending on province |
| Low-value threshold for non-US/Mexico shipments | Only C$20, so almost all shipments pay tax |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

#### Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **Business Number** with an import (RM) account
- **CARM** registration

#### Labelling

Under the Textile Labelling Act, garments need **fibre content in both English and French** and a **CA identification number** (or your name and address). We can stitch labels to these requirements.

#### Tips for boutiques

- Include duty and GST in your landed cost from the start
- Diwali, Vaisakhi and the summer wedding season are peak times
- Larger, less frequent shipments reduce clearance costs

### Australia

Under the **India–Australia Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement (ECTA)**, in force since **29 December 2022**, Indian-origin garments like kurtis and suits can be imported at **0% duty** (standard rate 5%) with a valid **certificate of origin**. **10% GST** applies at import for consignments over **A$1,000**. You need an **ABN**.

#### Duty and tax at a glance

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Standard duty | 5% |
| Duty under ECTA (Indian origin, with certificate) | **0%** |
| GST | 10% (consignments over A$1,000) |
| Consignments of A$1,000 or less | No border duty or GST |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

#### Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **ABN**
- **ECTA certificate of origin** from an authorised Indian body, to claim 0% duty
- A full import declaration for consignments over A$1,000

#### Labelling

Australia has a mandatory **care labelling** standard for clothing. We can stitch care labels and your brand labels.

#### Tips for boutiques

- Diwali, Navratri and the summer wedding season are the busiest times – order 6–8 weeks ahead
- Ask us for the certificate of origin with every shipment so you get the 0% rate
- Start with samples of 3–5 designs before ordering in bulk

### UAE

Under the **India–UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)**, in force since **1 May 2022**, Indian-origin apparel can be imported at **0% duty** (standard GCC rate 5%) with a **CEPA certificate of origin**. **5% VAT** applies at import. Express shipping from India usually takes about **5–10 business days**.

#### Duty and tax at a glance

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Standard GCC duty | 5% |
| Duty under CEPA (Indian origin, with certificate) | **0%** |
| VAT at import | 5% |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

#### Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- **CEPA certificate of origin**, to claim 0% duty
- Your **trade licence** and **customs code**

#### Labelling

Labelling rules for retail goods, including Arabic labels, can apply. Confirm with your customs broker; we can stitch labels to your requirements.

#### Tips for boutiques

- Eid, Diwali and the winter wedding season are peak times – order 6–8 weeks ahead
- Fast transit makes small, frequent reorders easy
- Ask for the CEPA certificate with every shipment

### Singapore

Singapore charges **no customs duty on clothing**, so kurtis and suits from India pay only **9% GST** at import (confirm low-value rules with your courier). Your courier usually files the import permit using your **UEN**. Express shipping takes about **5–10 business days**.

#### Duty and tax at a glance

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Customs duty on apparel | 0% |
| GST at import | 9% |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

#### Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **UEN** with an activated customs account (the courier files the permit)

#### Labelling

There is no specific mandatory textile label, but fibre and care labels help your customers. We can stitch your own labels.

#### Tips for boutiques

- Deepavali and Pongal are peak seasons – order 6–8 weeks ahead
- Fast transit makes small, frequent reorders easy
- Test 3–5 designs first, then reorder bestsellers

### Malaysia

Women's garments like kurtis and suits (HS 6204) are generally listed at **0% import duty** in Malaysia, but **10% sales tax (SST)** applies at import. Express courier shipments from India usually take about **5–10 business days**. Order from a manufacturer that offers a **low MOQ** so you can test designs with your customers before buying in bulk.

#### Duty and tax at a glance

| Item | Malaysia rule |
|---|---|
| Import duty on HS 6204 (women's suits and ensembles) | Generally 0% (confirm your exact HS code) |
| Sales tax at import | 10% |
| Low-value courier shipments | Shipments of RM500 or less are exempt at the border, but most wholesale orders are above this |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

#### Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **SSM company registration** details for clearance (check with your courier)

#### Tips for Malaysian boutiques and live sellers

- **Deepavali** and **Thaipusam** are the biggest seasons for Indian wear. Order 6–8 weeks ahead.
- Live and TikTok Shop sellers need **new designs often**. We add 4–5 new designs every week.
- Start with **samples of 3–5 designs**, test them on a live, then reorder the bestsellers.
- Ask for **mixed sizes** within one design (S to XXL) to match your customers.

*This guide is general information for buyers, not legal or customs advice. Duty rates depend on the exact HS code and fabric, and rules change, so always confirm with your customs broker or courier before importing. Information checked November 2026.*

faq.q: What is the tariff on clothing from India to the USA in 2026?
faq.a: Indian garments pay the normal MFN duty for their HTS code plus an additional 10% tariff on Indian goods (as of November 2026). The exact base rate depends on the HTS line and fibre, so confirm it with a customs broker.

faq.q: Is the $800 de minimis still available for Indian clothing?
faq.a: No. The de minimis exemption is suspended, so all shipments pay duty.

faq.q: What labels do Indian kurtis need in the USA?
faq.a: Fibre content, country of origin (Made in India), manufacturer or dealer identity such as an RN number, and a permanent care label.

faq.q: What is your minimum order?
faq.a: 15 to 20 pieces per design, with mixed sizes allowed.

faq.q: Is there import duty on kurtis from India to the UK?
faq.a: Since 15 July 2026, Indian-origin women's garments can enter the UK at 0% duty under the UK–India CETA, if you have proof of origin. Without it the standard rate is 12%. Import VAT of 20% still applies.

faq.q: Do I need an EORI number to import kurtis to the UK?
faq.a: Yes. Businesses importing goods into Great Britain need a GB EORI number.

faq.q: What is the minimum order from Bahe Kurtiz?
faq.a: 15 to 20 pieces per design, and sizes can be mixed.

faq.q: Can you put my brand label on the kurtis?
faq.a: Yes. We offer private label with your neck labels, care labels, hang tags and packaging.

faq.q: What is the duty on clothing imported from India to Canada?
faq.a: Women's garments usually pay 18% customs duty plus 5% GST and any provincial tax. Confirm the exact tariff line with your broker.

faq.q: What labels do kurtis need in Canada?
faq.a: Fibre content in English and French, plus a CA dealer identification number or your name and address.

faq.q: Is there import duty on kurtis from India to Australia?
faq.a: Indian-origin garments can enter at 0% duty under the India–Australia ECTA with a valid certificate of origin. Without it the standard rate is 5%. GST of 10% applies to consignments over A$1,000.

faq.q: What documents do I need to import kurtis to Australia?
faq.a: A commercial invoice, the exporter's IEC, your ABN, and an ECTA certificate of origin to claim the 0% rate.

faq.q: Is there import duty on kurtis from India to the UAE?
faq.a: Indian-origin apparel can enter at 0% duty under the India–UAE CEPA with a CEPA certificate of origin. Without it the standard rate is 5%. VAT of 5% applies at import.

faq.q: How long does shipping from India to Dubai take?
faq.a: Express courier shipments often take about 1 to 3 days after dispatch.

faq.q: Is there import duty on clothes from India to Singapore?
faq.a: No. Singapore charges no customs duty on clothing. GST of 9% applies at import.

faq.q: How long does shipping from India to Singapore take?
faq.a: Express courier shipments usually take about 2 to 4 days after dispatch.

faq.q: Is there import duty on Indian kurtis in Malaysia?
faq.a: Women's suits and ensembles under HS 6204 are generally listed at 0% duty, but 10% sales tax applies at import. Confirm the exact HS code with your courier or broker.

faq.q: How long does shipping from India to Malaysia take?
faq.a: Express courier shipments usually take about 2 to 4 days after dispatch.

faq.q: Can I order small quantities for my boutique?
faq.a: Yes. Our MOQ is 15 to 20 pieces per design, and you can mix sizes.

faq.q: Do you make designs for Deepavali and Thaipusam?
faq.a: Yes. We make festive Anarkalis, kurta sets and custom colours, such as yellow sets for Thaipusam. Order 6 to 8 weeks before the festival.
